reviews.text: If I could give him a half star I would. He is very rude. I hired him to train my 2 labs. I couldn’t be at the training any longer due to having eye surgery. My son was going to continue training. He straight up told me my son couldn’t do the training. Of course I didn’t get any money refunded to me.

DO NOT RECOMMEND !
He was forcing me to pay him money upfront when he hadn’t even trained my dog one sesh! When I confronted him he got aggravated and started to yell at my house at 7 AM on a Saturday while my family was asleep ! He stole nearly 900$ of my money and told me he wouldn’t come back if I didn’t pay the 1500$ for the classes.

I’m sure he’s going to write how i was the bad guy and I missed so many things but I have proof SS of everything.
